speech.p: Every child in every school deserves a great education, no matter where they live or how much their parents earn. Needs-based funding means the schools with the greatest challenges receive the resources to meet them.

In Riverbend, teachers have told me that smaller classes and more support for literacy and numeracy in the early years make the biggest difference. This bill delivers that support and links it to improvement plans for every school.
Nobody in this place disagrees that schools matter. The question is whether this bill will improve results for students or simply add another layer of administration for principals and teachers.

The government has not explained how it will pay for these commitments. A budget that relies on revenue that never arrives is not a plan, and the deficit this year is larger than forecast. The economy needs a credible path back to surplus before new spending is promised for a decade.
